pictures.name: dry_seed_on_bare_dust
pictures.scene: a scatter of hard dry seed lying on bare grey dust with no green anywhere near it, the nearest seeds lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the dead ground beyond them flat and pale and still

pictures.name: two_lamps_answering_across_a_valley
pictures.scene: one lamp burning on a near ridge and another answering it far across a dark valley, the near flame lit warm and gold low in the frame, the gulf of night between the two lights deep and blue and quiet

pictures.name: mist_lifting_off_a_hill_path
pictures.scene: morning mist drawing back off a climbing hill path and leaving the way plain to see, the near track lit warm and clear at the bottom of the frame, the slope above it soft and pale and opening out

pictures.name: wax_running_down_a_burning_candle
pictures.scene: a thick candle burning low with soft wax running in slow folds down its side, the pooled wax lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the flame and the dark air above it quiet and deep

pictures.name: false_track_blocked_with_thorns
pictures.scene: a side path closed off by a dense cut thorn bush dragged right across it, the near thorns lit hard and warm at the bottom of the frame, the way behind them dim and overgrown and going nowhere

pictures.name: straight_furrow_ploughed_to_a_marker
pictures.scene: one long furrow ploughed dead straight across a field toward a single upright stake, the near turned earth lit warm and dark at the bottom of the frame, the field and marker beyond it pale and quiet

pictures.name: roots_gripping_a_rock_ledge
pictures.scene: the thick roots of a small tree gripped hard around the edge of a bare rock ledge, the roots and stone lit warm and hard at the bottom of the frame, the drop and sky beyond them soft and pale

pictures.name: broad_open_track_running_downhill
pictures.scene: a wide smooth track opening out and running freely away downhill into bright country, the near surface lit warm and gold at the bottom of the frame, the valley and sky ahead of it wide and clear

lines.text: My soul cleaves to the dust;
revive me according to Your word.
I recounted my ways, and You answered me;
Make clear to me the way of Your precepts;
then I will meditate on Your wonders.
strengthen me according to Your word.
Remove me from the path of deceit
and graciously grant me Your law.
I have chosen the way of truth;
I have set Your ordinances before me.
I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD;
let me not be put to shame.
I run in the path of Your commandments,
for You will enlarge my heart.
